items.title: Add ignored root authority_trust.env support for Authority config resolution
items.context: User provided /Users/jek/Documents/Work/Koala/cord-team/authority_trust.env and wants it placed at the Lattice CLI root for default Authority Server connection. The fix must keep secrets untracked, load the file only for Authority config paths, map LIVE_URL/LIVE_PUBLIC_KEY/CUSTOMER_API_KEY_FILE aliases to canonical LATTICE_AUTHORITY_* fields, and preserve precedence: explicit CLI/env overrides win over the file.
items.userSees: 用户运行 `lattice authority_status --authorityMode=enforce --json` 后能看到：`"baseURLConfigured": true`、`"customerApiKeyConfigured": true`、`"urlSource": "authority_trust_env"`；如果显式导出 URL/key，则输出仍使用显式配置。

happy.desc: authority_trust.env with LIVE_URL/LIVE_PUBLIC_KEY/CUSTOMER_API_KEY_FILE resolves to canonical Authority config when explicit env is absent

edge.desc: explicit LATTICE_AUTHORITY_URL and CUSTOMER_API_KEY_PATH override authority_trust.env values
missing authority_trust.env remains non-fatal and falls back to existing authority.md/default behavior

adversarial.desc: authority_trust.env remains gitignored and real secret values are not printed or committed

verificationEvidence.note: authority-client smoke covers root authority_trust.env parsing, LIVE_URL/LIVE_PUBLIC_KEY/CUSTOMER_API_KEY_FILE alias normalization, ${VAR:-fallback} expansion, and canonical Authority config resolution.
authority-client smoke asserts precedence CLI/env > authority_trust_env > authority.md/default and customer API key env/path still override trust-file values.
smokes cover missing trust env as non-fatal and existing authority.md/default behavior, while policy discovery can use trust env URL when present.
authority_trust.env reports as ignored (!!) in the story worktree, git diff --check is clean, and real-file verification only printed non-sensitive booleans/basenames, not secret values.

items.title: Verify Authority status uses the default trust file without Authority overclaim
items.context: Authority default loading must improve readiness diagnostics and connection inputs, but must not set authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone or claim receipt verification without a real Authority receipt.
items.userSees: 用户运行 `lattice authority_status --authorityMode=enforce --json` 后能看到 readiness 字段补齐，同时仍看到：`"receiptVerified": false`、`"productionDone": false`、`"canClaimProductionDone": false`。

happy.desc: authority_status in enforce mode reports URL/customer key/server key readiness from root authority_trust.env

edge.desc: authority trust file readiness does not require or imply actor key/runner id if the file does not provide them

adversarial.desc: no combination of default trust-file values sets receiptVerified, productionDone, fullAuthorityDone, or canClaimProductionDone without verified receipt evidence

verificationEvidence.command: node packages/main/dist/tasks/authority-status-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/cli.js authority_status --authorityMode=enforce --json | non-sensitive JSON projection
verificationEvidence.note: authority_status smoke and real-file projection show authorityTrustEnvLoaded=true, urlSource=authority_trust_env, baseURLConfigured=true, customerApiKeyConfigured=true, customerApiKeySource=authority_trust_env, and serverPublicKeyPinned=true.

verificationEvidence.command: node packages/main/dist/tasks/authority-status-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/cli.js authority_status --authorityMode=enforce --json | non-sensitive JSON projection
verificationEvidence.note: status smoke and real-file projection keep actorKeyConfigured=false and runnerConfigured=false when the trust file does not provide actor/runner fields; readiness warnings remain for those missing inputs.
status smoke asserts trust-file readiness never sets receiptVerified, productionDone, or canClaimProductionDone without verified receipt-backed Authority evidence.
